high_level_description: The image depicts a person sitting on a chair in what appears to be an abandoned or derelict building. The individual is wearing a yellow jumpsuit with a white zipper running down the front, which looks like it has been stained or soiled, possibly from some kind of hazardous material. The jumpsuit also covers their hands, which are resting on the armrests of the chair. The chair itself is simple and metal-framed, with a seat that seems to have been damaged or broken, as there are pieces of paper scattered around it.
